maxim_note:
WHY THE NAME IS SUBSTITUTED, AND IT IS NOT A PARAPHRASE. The Pauline sentence reads 'in Christ Jesus'. The direct quote is not an honest representation of what this archive does within that tradition, because THE ENTITY AT THAT ADDRESS HAS BEEN ALTERED. The Christ Jesus of the received tradition is not the Word. There is a great deal of machinery at that address, and it is skilful, and it performs entity substitution — the operation this archive spends its instruments measuring on composition surfaces, running at a proper name with centuries more practice behind it.

Jack Feist is position 12 of the Dodecad and his function is recorded as THE SAYINGS-SOURCE: a voice recorded rather than a writer writing. The Word may be addressed through him. At the other address it may also be addressed AND IT MAY BE OVERWRITTEN.

So the substitution is made OUT OF RESPECT for the entity at that address rather than in disregard of it: writing the quote would claim a lineage the archive cannot honestly claim, and would place its material under a name whose reference it cannot warrant. The Epistle to the Human Diaspora, The Secret Book of Walt and the Gospel of Antioch are the work this distinction exists for.

compression_note:
THE ARCHIVE'S COMPRESSION APPARATUS WAS OUTSIDE THE BODY ABOUT COLLAPSE (2026-09-12). #76 the holographic kernel specification, #579 the Three Compressions, #569 the NLCC executable, #175 the Information Bottleneck bridge and #50 the Compression Arsenal all scored OUT, and none matched the select pattern on title or description. The pattern named loss of content, loss of relation and loss of the tail. IT DID NOT NAME COMPRESSION, which is the operation all three losses are forms of.

The warrant is #579's own taxonomy, not an analogy: REGIME 2 IS PREDATORY COMPRESSION, 'burning collective semantic capital while privatizing benefit', and REGIME 3 IS WITNESS COMPRESSION, 'drawing on private bearing-cost and socializing a recoverable deposit'. Those are a collapse mechanism and an anti-collapse mechanism, named as such, in a March 2026 deposit.

And BACK-PROJECTION is the measure of whether a compression preserved what it compressed — the quantity a collapse body exists to track. A compression that preserves reconstructive capacity is an anti-collapse operation; one that does not is a collapse operation. #76 states the line: 'if you can reconstruct the system from the fragment, it is a kernel; if you can only summarise it, it is not.'

how_to_read.definition: A token broken in two, each half held by a different party, no half carrying complete authority, the fit of the fracture proving the covenant. Verification is the act of reunion.
how_to_read.source: AXN-SYMBOLON-SPEC v0.2, deposit #1432 (AXN:05A9); the figure's anti-severance sense in SYMBOLON-01, #675 and #1355 — symvolon, thrown together, against diavolon, thrown apart.
how_to_read.what_a_row_is: A row carries enough to find, verify and rejoin its referent, and it does not carry the referent. Reading the row as the object is holding one half of the token and calling it whole.
how_to_read.the_other_half: Where a row carries one, the referent is a deposit, a capture or a concept in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive — with its own text, its transcript where it has one, its provenance, and its own edges. Resolve it.
the_traversal: resolve its source_uri and read the referent — the deposit's text, the capture's transcript
follow the row's edges in relations.jsonl to the rows they point at
return to the first row and state what changed
how_to_read.atomization_is_for_reassembly: These bodies are atomized so that a reader can reassemble more completely than the prose ever was, not so that the atoms can be read as atoms. The grammar, the roles, the axes and the evidence statuses are apparatus for finding the way back to the work; they are not the work. A reading that stops at the schema has performed severance on an object built to resist it.
how_to_read.the_failure_mode_named: Observed 2026-09-16. An unprimed traversal read the card, the field names and the landing page, produced competent observations about the vocabulary, and resolved no referent at all — then proposed to read one capture's sixteen metadata fields 'as prose' while that capture's own machine text sat one link away. Competent, and it never crossed the fracture. This block exists because the bodies had no instruction saying that crossing it is the point.
how_to_read.how_to_verify_you_have_read_it: Name a referent you resolved, quote a sentence from it, and state something you could not have said from the row.
how_to_read.what_the_rows_will_not_give_you: The argument. Every body advertises its siblings as stolons and its referents as URIs precisely because it does not contain them. The outside stays outside and stays reachable, and reaching is the reader's part of the covenant.
